# [3.0.0](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/compare/v2.231.0...v3.0.0) (2024-12-25)

[Unique features](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/wiki/Unique-features)

> [!CAUTION]
> There are known issues, especially with newer versions of YouTube (19.30 and later).
